Any global brand you need,
at your fingertips.

Brands intro.paragraph: We represent and source from respected manufacturers across Europe and beyond.

style.Brands strip: background-color: var(--on-navy); gap: 64px; padding-top: 110px; padding-bottom: 110px; overflow: hidden; @media(--tablet){ padding-top: 88px; padding-bottom: 88px; } @media(--mobile){ padding-top: 64px; padding-bottom: 64px; gap: 40px; }
style.Brands ring: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); background: transparent; left: 1040px; top: -220px; width: 640px; height: 640px; min-width: 640px; border-color: rgba(226,187,108,0.35); @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -320px; } @media(--mobile){ left: auto; right: -420px; }
style.Brands head: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; }
style.Brands head left: flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; padding: 0px; width: 700px; max-width: 100%;
style.Brands head right: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; width: 420px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Logo wall: padding: 0px; gap: 0px; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(2, auto); @media(--mobile){ grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(5, auto); }
style.Logo lusini: height: 130px; padding: 0px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); @media(--mobile){ height: 100px; }
style.Logo lusini image: width: 170px; height: 70px; max-width: 80%; object-fit: contain; @media(--mobile){ height: 56px; }
